issues.description: The milk-related interface is named inconsistently across artifacts. The problem statement (UML) and the template Main.java refer to an interface named 'Milkable' that should declare messageOnMilk(). In the solution repository the interface is named 'Dairy' (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Dairy.java) and the concrete animal classes (Seal.java and Goat.java) implement Dairy. Meanwhile src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java in the solution is an empty file. This mismatch (Milkable vs. Dairy, plus an empty Milkable.java) creates confusion for students mapping requirements to code and may cause compilation/test failures when tests or the template expect 'Milkable'.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Prefer aligning the solution with the problem/template: rename the solution's Dairy.java to Milkable.java (update package and filename), declare String messageOnMilk() in it, and update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement Milkable. Remove the empty src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java if it was left behind, or replace its contents with the correct interface. Alternatively (less recommended), update the problem statement and template to use 'Dairy' everywhere — but ensure a single interface name is used in all materials and tests.
